posts.post_caption:
Frontier AI ownership just cracked open from both sides of the Pacific at once.

Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling - 975 billion parameters, multimodal reasoning over text, images, and audio, full open weights on Hugging Face. Free to download, run, and modify. A former OpenAI CTO putting a frontier-class system into the global commons.

Chinese open models already hold 41% of Hugging Face downloads and all six top production slots on OpenRouter. An American open release from a founder of this caliber means the diffusion is accelerating across borders and across the founder class at the same time.

When capability that cost hundreds of millions to train becomes a file on a hard drive, the advantage of having trained it first carries a shrinking shelf life. The open commons keeps compounding.

Watch the full episode here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LPLJ_vXBwvw

Get the full story on all of this and much more - read the full edition of today's Century Report here: https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-july-16-2026/
